title: The Quiet Cipher
author: Lior Brightwater
blurb: Juniper Brightwater, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
